title: Meridian Advisory: the Q3 outlook and where boards are moving
preheaderText: Our read on the quarter ahead: three shifts on the board agenda, and how the teams getting ahead are responding.
heroImageAlt: An abstract ascending chart cresting a horizon line
heroHeadline: Clarity for the decision in front of you
heroText: Every quarter we distill what we are seeing across the desk into a short brief. This one covers three shifts moving up the board agenda, and the practical moves the teams ahead of them are already making.
serviceATitle: Set the direction, then defend it
serviceAText: We help leadership teams pick a defensible position and build the operating plan that holds it under pressure. Fewer initiatives, sequenced properly, owned clearly.
serviceBText: Our analysts pressure-test the model behind the plan so the board sees the real range of outcomes, not a single optimistic line. Assumptions surfaced, risks priced, evidence attached.
quoteText: Meridian gave our board the one thing a deck never could: a clear read on the trade-offs, and the confidence to actually decide.
quoteRole: Chair of the Board, Northarbor Group
ctaHeadline: Bring us the decision that is keeping you up
ctaText: A first conversation is thirty minutes and costs nothing. We will tell you plainly whether we can help and how we would start.
